_comment: Copy this to ~/.grok/wa-registry.json and fill in your own values. That file stays on your machine and is never committed. Skills resolve aliases here; the repo ships zero real numbers.

provider._note_type: Reference adapter. Any provider that lists messages and (after consent-gate) sends a message can be wired the same way. Skills own workflow; the provider is yours.
provider._note_org_phone: The number your provider account sends from. Digits only, country code, no +. Recipients see this number's saved name — not an AI brand.
provider._note_sender_phone: Read identity. Some providers only return messages this number participated in. Wrong value → empty slice, no error. Keep the real value on your machine.

me.note: Your own DM. Notes-to-self / notification target.

team.style: concise, fact-based, lead with the outcome
team.note: A group chat. Group ids end in @g.us.

teammate.note: A one-to-one chat. DM ids end in @c.us.

inference._comment: Optional. When a pull/draft has no explicit target, score known aliases against the current conversation. Keep this file local.

sender_resolution._comment: Optional. Map a sender id to a display name for readable pull output. Without an entry, the raw id is shown locally — still do not paste raw ids into git.

posture._note: LibreWhatsApp-Grok-Build does not honor a skip-preview flag. Confirm phrases live in the consent-gate skill.
